definitions.explanation: water escaping from pipes, tanks, or other containers

examples.japanese: {洗面台|せんめんだい}の{下|した}で{水漏|みずも}れを{発見|はっけん}した。
examples.english: I found a water leak under the sink.

examples.japanese: {水漏|みずも}れの{修理|しゅうり}を{業者|ぎょうしゃ}に{依頼|いらい}した。
examples.english: I asked a contractor to repair the water leak.

notes:
{水漏|みずも}れ refers to water leaking from plumbing, appliances, or containers.

COMPOUND STRUCTURE:
- {水|みず} (water) + {漏|も}れ (leak, noun form of {漏|も}れる)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {水漏|みずも}れがする (there is a water leak)
- {水漏|みずも}れが{起|お}きる (a water leak occurs)
- {水漏|みずも}れを{直|なお}す (to fix a water leak)
- {水漏|みずも}れを{修理|しゅうり}する (to repair a water leak)
- {水漏|みずも}れを{防|ふせ}ぐ (to prevent water leaks)

COMMON LOCATIONS:
- {水道管|すいどうかん} (water pipes)
- {蛇口|じゃぐち} (faucet)
- {洗面台|せんめんだい} (sink)
- {洗濯機|せんたくき} (washing machine)
- トイレ (toilet)
- {給湯器|きゅうとうき} (water heater)

RELATED TERMS:
- {雨漏|あまも}り (roof leak)
- {水道管|すいどうかん} (water pipe)
- {漏電|ろうでん} (electrical leak)
- パッキン (packing, washer - often cause of leaks)

URGENCY:
- Often requires immediate attention
- Can cause water damage ({水濡|みずぬ}れ)
- May affect neighbors in apartments

CULTURAL NOTE:
- In Japanese apartments, tenants typically contact:
  - {管理会社|かんりがいしゃ} (management company)
  - {大家|おおや} (landlord)
- Emergency contacts often provided for {水回|みずまわ}りトラブル (plumbing issues)

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in everyday conversation.
